senses.gloss: the tanning process, tannery, [fr. (= בעל ב׳) the tanner; v. בּוּרְסִי].
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:2">Sabb. I, 2</cite> <he>ולא לב׳</he> nor must one enter the tannery (to look after the process, shortly before Sabbath). Ib. 9ᵇ <he>התחלת כ׳</he> the beginning of the tanner’s work. Ib. <he>ב׳ גדולה</he> a tannery on a large scale; v. <cite ref="B00385"><he>בּוּרְסִי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 21b:9">B. Bath. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>ולא ב׳</he> nor to put up a tanner’s workshop; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4:4">Cant. R. to I, 4</cite>.
